caption:
Lulu flies around the court with fast lunges and quick turns. After every game, her knees and back ache.

Squash and badminton involve lots of sudden stops and changes of direction. Keeping your knee in line with your toes in a lunge and using your trunk may share the load.

Hybi's tip: a 30-second single-leg stand each side, 8 slow lunges each side and 8 lying knee rolls. Warm up with some light jogging before you play.

A knee that swells or gives way, or trouble taking weight, are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏸
